method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A flat board with a meaningless gold block; the camera between two disconnected plates.
notes.fix: One screwed wall plate and a single arm; magnetic case strips with bevels and a pen tray; the gold block steel.

notes.problem: A Gantt-like board, a robot-arm rig, a gold block, a dead band above the tile.
notes.fix: Recolour the gold block, one wall plate, lens axis on the board's lanes, modelled magnets and tray, tile raised to the dek.

notes.problem: The boom arm runs from one wall plate to a second white plate; the board is flat coloured rectangles.
notes.fix: One plate and a single two-joint arm; raised case magnets, a marker tray and frame edge casting under a raking key.

notes.problem: A pale grey plate carrying DOM type, lifting the frame into the mid tones.
notes.fix: Bleed the page off the bottom and right edges, rake the key low, steel to near black.

notes.problem: A mid-tone beige quote card, flattest bands in the deck.
notes.fix: Cut the page to about 60 percent of its area, curl it so it casts, one narrow raking pool falling off hard below the c13 line.

notes.problem: A pale page of type in the mid tones.
notes.fix: Narrow the key to the page's top half and the clip so the rest falls toward black.

notes.problem: A flat floor plan with stub cameras.
notes.fix: A three-quarter oblique view with walls three times taller; larger camera brackets.

notes.problem: A card-grey floor plan, dark-stub cameras with gold rings.
notes.fix: A 30 degree oblique aerial, cameras 1.5 times larger with cold white rings.

notes.problem: A flat grey-box floor plan with four dark-stub cameras.
notes.fix: A 30 to 40 degree oblique view; pale housings with lit lenses.

notes.problem: Bays and lids seen square read as a spreadsheet grid.
notes.fix: A low oblique view so lids stand in perspective; the white tape a bright ridge.

notes.problem: A mid grey grid whose last rows sink into the footer; bay 41 unmarked.
notes.fix: Shorten the bays about 15 percent; tape the high end at bay 41 too.

notes.problem: A mid-grey towel texture; clamps read as tweezers.
notes.fix: A pool on the gold clamp with the rest to black; curved jaws, box lock and ratchet teeth.

notes.problem: An empty weave band between the dek and the clamps.
notes.fix: Move the rank up about 250 px, rings off the bottom edge, a lower key for longer casts.

notes.problem: The body reads as matte clay; the camera wedged against the dek; an empty tile band.
notes.fix: A metallic low-roughness anodised material with a key streak; move the camera into the lit pool clear of the dek.

notes.problem: An evenly lit wall reading as a flat block with a tan band.
notes.fix: A real pool from high left with the right third and corners falling to black; the same on 3.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
